description: A streamed Messages request with extended thinking: the Responses reasoning item (summary deltas, then output_item.done with encrypted_content) becomes a thinking block whose signature is the encrypted content, followed by the text block.
source: core/internal/translator/codex/claude/codex_claude_response.go (ConvertCodexResponseToClaude: response.output_item.added reasoning, response.reasoning_summary_part.added, response.reasoning_summary_text.delta, response.output_item.done reasoning; finalizeCodexThinkingBlock)

headers.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Api-Key, X-Goog-Api-Key, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta
headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
headers.Access-Control-Expose-Headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, ETag, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

exceptions.reason: Today's core puts its own local estimate of the input tokens in message_start; the new core has no tokenizer and sends 0 there, as Anthropic's message_start allows, until message_delta carries the upstream's count.

Today's core carries Codex reasoning through Messages clients: it puts a Responses reasoning item's encrypted_content in the thinking block's signature (a signature_delta), and turns a GPT-shaped signature in a replayed thinking block back into a reasoning item with encrypted_content, after its own signature-shape checks. The new core reports reasoning from another provider as dropped and sends rebuilt thinking blocks without a signature. Whether to carry encrypted reasoning across formats, and how to check it, is open (Codex reasoning replay, slice 9).

Today's core reaches a Responses upstream only through its Codex API-key provider, which reshapes the request for the Codex endpoint (system as developer, empty instructions, include, store false, parallel_tool_calls, tool_choice auto, strict false on tools, prompt_cache_key and Session-Id, an image_generation tool, every request streamed). The new core's generic Responses upstream gets the translated request without them; Codex endpoint rules belong to the Codex provider extension.
